# NoxFeed

> A macOS menubar client for your GitHub team's PR activity. Turns your
> org's PR + issue flow into a live, AI-narrated feed you can glance at
> without opening the browser.

## Product

- Menubar-first macOS app: three-mode feed (Opened / Merged / Notes)
- Current tab shows a per-person view of open PRs, review requests, and
  assigned issues with counts
- PR detail with a toggle between the GitHub page and noxfeed's release
  notes
- Multi-account (multiple GitHub identities) + multi-org support
- Global hotkey ⌘⇧X to open from anywhere
- Full native window when you want the big view
- Free on the Mac App Store

## Backend

- Workspace at app.unticket.ai — Cloudflare Workers + D1
- Connects to GitHub via a GitHub App installation
- Data flows GitHub → workspace → app; nothing exposed publicly
